identity: A WB aristocrats deck that uses Clerics as its fodder and blocking layer rather than as a tribe. Seventeen creatures plus a stream of tokens feed five kinds of sacrifice outlet - Phyrexian Warhorse at {1}, Gibbering Barricade at {2}{B} for a card, Braids, Arisen Nightmare for free at end step, Braids's Frightful Return chapter I, and Bone Splinters as removal - and every death is converted into value by six payoff cards. Elas il-Kor turns deaths directly into opponent life loss and is the single best draw in the deck, but it is a 1-of Legendary, so the deck is built to grind on Weatherlight Compleated's per-death counters, Gibbering Barricade's card, Phyrexian Vivisector's scry and Braids's draw-or-drain even when Elas never appears. Four Defender bodies (Gibbering Barricade x2, Wingmantle Chaplain x2) hold the ground while Wingmantle turns them into flying Birds - the deck's only answer to a cube whose largest threat class is 51 evasive creatures. Six Cleric cards (a seventh on demand via Evolved Sleeper) honour the constraint without the deck depending on the type.

sideboard.name: Extinguish the Light
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the 28 of 157 pool creatures that neither Cut Down (total power+toughness 5 or less) nor Destroy Evil (toughness 4 or greater) can hit - a 4/3 is missed by both. Also the only planeswalker answer in the 50.

sideboard.name: Prayer of Binding
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against artifacts (15 in the cube, 6.1%) - the mainboard's only noncreature answer is Destroy Evil's enchantment mode. Chosen over Leyline Binding, which has the same flash-exile-any-nonland-permanent effect at the same effective cost with 2 basic land types, because Prayer is uncommon and the 5 rare slots are fully spent.

sideboard.name: Sengir Connoisseur
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more other creatures die, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. This ability triggers only once each turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the evasion class - 51 cards at 20.6% density, the largest in the cube, and 41 of the 51 have flying. 'Flying. Whenever one or more other creatures die, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature' is a flying blocker that grows off the deck's own sacrifice engine, which is the only way this shell contests the air.

sideboard.name: Benalish Sleeper
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {B} (You may pay an additional {B} as you cast this spell.)
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the 7 ward/hexproof creatures in the cube that targeted removal cannot reach - kicked for {B} it reads 'each player sacrifices a creature of their choice'. The symmetric half is upside: our own sacrifice triggers Elas il-Kor, Weatherlight Compleated and Phyrexian Vivisector, and satisfies Cult Conscript's recursion clause.

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against lifegain decks - 'Your opponents can't gain life' shuts off a 22-card, 8.9%-density class, which is the single thing that undoes an incremental drain plan.

identity_es: Un mazo de aristócratas WB que usa los Clérigos como forraje y capa de bloqueo en lugar de como tribu. Diecisiete criaturas más un flujo de fichas alimentan cinco tipos de medio de sacrificio — Phyrexian Warhorse por {1}, Gibbering Barricade por {2}{B} a cambio de una carta, Braids, Arisen Nightmare gratis en el paso final, el capítulo I de Braids's Frightful Return, y Bone Splinters como eliminación — y cada muerte se convierte en valor por seis cartas de recompensa. Elas il-Kor convierte las muertes directamente en pérdida de vida del rival y es la mejor carta que se puede robar en el mazo, pero es una legendaria de copia única, así que el mazo está construido para desgastar con los contadores por muerte de Weatherlight Compleated, la carta de Gibbering Barricade, el scry de Phyrexian Vivisector y el robar-o-drenar de Braids incluso cuando Elas nunca aparece. Cuatro cuerpos con Defensor (Gibbering Barricade x2, Wingmantle Chaplain x2) sostienen el suelo mientras Wingmantle los convierte en Pájaros voladores, la única respuesta del mazo a un cubo cuya mayor clase de amenaza son 51 criaturas evasivas. Seis cartas de Clérigo (una séptima a demanda vía Evolved Sleeper) honran la restricción sin que el mazo dependa del tipo.
